name: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd. (IndiGo)
business_summary: India's largest airline (~65% domestic share in Sep 2026, down from higher; 86 destinations, 262 aircraft at last count). Low-cost single-type fleet, leased heavily, with USD-linked costs. FY26 net loss Rs2,394 cr; Q1 FY27 loss Rs238 cr; Q2 FY27 loss Rs1,879 cr (revenue Rs23,364 cr +26%) on higher fuel and a weak rupee. Q3 (Oct-Dec) is seasonally strong; crude has just eased, lifting the stock >6-7% on 2026-11-05. New airfare rules were notified on 2026-11-02, giving government intervention powers from 2027.

exposures.mechanism: ATF ~38% of costs (model estimate; ATF fell in Q2 FY27 profit via 'higher fuel costs' per company). +10% Brent => ATF ~+8% (taxes/crack buffer) => costs +3.0% => ~+Rs2.6k cr/yr on ~Rs86k cr costs; IndiGo recovers ~80-90% over time via fares (Nomura) but with 1-2 quarter lag, so net near-term hit ~40% = ~Rs1k cr = -9% of TTM EBITDA Rs11.4k cr; x EV/MCap 1.15 x persistence 0.25 => -2.6. Pack empirical -1.79 per +10% (t -3.8): strong agreement; central -2.5 (blend). Brent 94.99 now (+49.5% 12m, -5.6% 1m): large recent shock, now easing (stock +7% on 2026-11-05 as crude fell).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: net loss Rs1,878.6 cr (Rs2,581.7 cr yr ago), revenue Rs23,364 cr +26%, fuel and weak rupee cited
PRASK growth >25% guided for FY27 (analyst summary); Nomura: pricing captures 80-90% of cost increase

exposures.mechanism: Discretionary air travel is income-elastic (income elasticity ~1.5-2): +5pp urban consumption growth => +~4% pax => ~+2.5% revenue => +~16% EBITDA x1.15 x 0.2 = +3.7.

exposures.mechanism: Rules notified 2026-11-02 allow government intervention in fares in 'extraordinary situations' from 2027 (finalised before SC's Nov-16 deadline). +1 SSU = binding caps/pass-through limits in peak/stress periods. A cap that blocks ~20% of fuel/FX pass-through in stress quarters => -Rs 0.5-1k cr/yr = -4 to -9% EBITDA, x1.15 x persistence 1.0, but market reaction on 2026-11-02 was positive (rules milder than feared), so range allows +2. Central -6 for the cap-risk level; the -2% reaction on 2026-10-16, when rules were first reported as finalised, shows the sign is two-sided.
